# Deployment Lifecycle {#sec-deployment-improvement}

::: {.callout-note title="Outline scaffold"}

This page makes the agreed chapter architecture renderable in Quarto. It records the chapter question, planned coverage, and intended systems outcome; full manuscript prose, figures, worked examples, fallacies, and exercises remain to be developed.

:::

## Chapter Question {.unnumbered}

_How should an agentic system enter production and improve without expanding risk faster than evidence?_

## Planned Coverage

- Staged rollout, canaries, shadowing, and authority expansion
- Service objectives for outcomes, intervention, safety, and cost
- Incident response and trajectory-level postmortems
- Data and feedback loops for controlled improvement
- Versioning models, prompts, tools, policies, and state schemas

## Intended Systems Outcome

Readers should be able to design a deployment and improvement loop in which authority expands only as operational evidence strengthens.
